td.hint.zh: 名称和海报会同步到 CrazyDramas 上的剧集。海报最好是 3:4 竖版图片（1200×1600）；其他比例会居中裁切。
td.hint.en: The name and poster also go to the series on CrazyDramas. A 3:4 portrait image (1200×1600) fits best; other shapes are centre-cropped.

td.slugMoved.en: The web address is now crazydramas.com/watch/{slug}.

td.cdUpdated.en: The series on CrazyDramas is updated.

td.cdLaterName.zh: 剧集还没上传到 CrazyDramas；上传时会使用这个名称。
td.cdLaterName.en: The series is not on CrazyDramas yet; it will be created with this name.

td.cdLaterPoster.zh: 剧集还没上传到 CrazyDramas；创建剧集时会使用这张海报。
td.cdLaterPoster.en: The series is not on CrazyDramas yet; it will be created with this poster.

td.adminOnly.zh: 只有管理员可以修改名称和海报。
td.adminOnly.en: Only an administrator can change the name and poster.
